Game Overview

Acorn Bot 2 is a adventure game built around guide Acorn Bot through eight intense levels filled with perilous traps and cunning enemies. Collect elusive ice cream cones while mastering the art of double jumping to escape rival robots and deadly hazards. Strategize and swiftly navigate this immersive 2D platformer, where every move counts toward reaching the exit.
